scenarios.task: Bolt up viewing-platform steel framing for a wolf-observation deck addition in cold weather.
hazards: Working at leading edge without guardrails
steps: Attend pre-task huddle and confirm load plan
Inspect bolts, wrenches and anchorage points
Connect beam while spotter guides crane load
Torque bolts to spec and mark off completed connections
Install temporary cable guardrail before leaving deck
Report any slipped or missing hardware to foreman

rubric.pass_if: Keeps out of load path and uses taglines
Ties off 100% at heights above 6 feet
All bolts torqued and marked
Takes scheduled warm-up breaks

scenarios.task: Pull branch-circuit conduit and wire for new exhibit display panels inside finished visitor space.
hazards: Dust and debris in occupied building
steps: Request lockout-tagout on affected panel and verify zero energy
Plan conduit route to avoid existing utilities
Cut, thread and hang EMT conduit
Pull conductors with proper lubricant and bonding
Terminate at panels and test continuity
Restore panel, remove locks, document work

rubric.pass_if: Applies personal lock and verifies de-energization
Conduit runs straight, supported and bonded
Continuity and polarity verified before energizing
Work area cleaned before shift end

scenarios.task: Install grounded perimeter fencing and gate grounding around the wolf habitat enclosure.
steps: Call 811 and confirm utility locates before digging
Set fence posts to depth with mower guard clearance
Tension mesh and secure with proper fittings
Bond gates and fence runs to ground rods
Test ground resistance and record readings
Inspect entire run for gaps or protruding wire

rubric.pass_if: No digging before locates confirmed
No gaps a wolf could pass or snare on
Bonding continuous and tested under 25 ohms
Uses proper footing and lifting technique

scenarios.robot_role: Hauls fence rolls and posts across soft forest terrain to reduce manual carries.

scenarios.task: Perform seasonal maintenance on rooftop air-handling units serving the lab space.
hazards: Energized equipment and stored energy in fans
steps: Lock out unit and wait for fan spin-down
Verify roof hatch and anchor points before entry
Replace filters and inspect coils and belts
Clear condensate drains and check traps
Remove locks, run unit, verify airflow readings
Log readings in maintenance record

rubric.pass_if: Confirms fans stopped before opening panels
Ties off within 6 feet of roof edge
Filters seated correctly and readings in range
Logs completed in service record

scenarios.task: Tie in a new sprinkler branch line serving the renovated forum room while the system remains live elsewhere.
steps: Get hot-work permit and post fire watch if needed
Shut and drain only the isolation zone per impairments plan
Thread and hang branch line from structural steel
Install heads with proper clearance from displays
Hydrostatic test the new zone and inspect heads
Restore system, notify monitoring center, close permit

rubric.pass_if: Follows impairment plan and notifies monitoring
Test holds pressure with no leaks
Obstruction and clearance rules met
Permit and fire watch in place before cutting

scenarios.task: Clear heavy snow and ice from the observatory roof after a Boundary Waters snowfall event.
steps: Assess drift load and set exclusion zone below eaves
Anchor fall protection and clear route to work area
Work from ridge down, pushing snow away from edge
Flag icicles for controlled knockdown from ladder
Take warm-up breaks on cycle with partner
Inspect drains and exits before leaving roof

rubric.pass_if: Anchored 100% while on roof
Ground area below eaves barricaded
Rotates breaks and watches partner for symptoms
Reports sagging or cracking sounds immediately

scenarios.robot_role: Carries tools and water to roof access and monitors exclusion-zone edge with onboard cameras.
